tables.definition: Audit table tracking all DDL changes made to the AdventureWorks database. Data is captured by the database trigger ddlDatabaseTriggerLog.

columns.name: DatabaseLogID
columns.definition: Primary key for DatabaseLog records.

columns.name: PostTime
columns.definition: The date and time the DDL change occurred.

columns.name: DatabaseUser
columns.definition: The user who implemented the DDL change.

columns.name: Event
columns.definition: The type of DDL statement that was executed.

columns.name: Schema
columns.definition: The schema to which the changed object belongs.

columns.name: Object
columns.definition: The object that was changed by the DDL statment.

columns.name: TSQL
columns.definition: The exact Transact-SQL statement that was executed.

columns.name: XmlEvent
columns.definition: The raw XML data generated by database trigger.

tables.sql_definition:
CREATE TABLE "DatabaseLog" (
  "DatabaseLogID" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "PostTime" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "DatabaseUser" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "Event" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "Schema" TEXT,
  "Object" TEXT,
  "TSQL" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "XmlEvent" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("DatabaseLogID")
)

tables.definition: Audit table tracking errors in the the AdventureWorks database that are caught by the CATCH block of a TRY...CATCH construct. Data is inserted by stored procedure dbo.uspLogError when it is executed from inside the CATCH block of a TRY...CATCH construct.

columns.name: ErrorLogID
columns.definition: Primary key for ErrorLog records.

columns.name: ErrorTime
columns.definition: The date and time at which the error occurred.

columns.name: UserName
columns.definition: The user who executed the batch in which the error occurred.

columns.name: ErrorNumber
columns.definition: The error number of the error that occurred.

columns.name: ErrorSeverity
columns.definition: The severity of the error that occurred.

columns.name: ErrorState
columns.definition: The state number of the error that occurred.

columns.name: ErrorProcedure
columns.definition: The name of the stored procedure or trigger where the error occurred.

columns.name: ErrorLine
columns.definition: The line number at which the error occurred.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.definition: The message text of the error that occurred.

tables.sql_definition:
CREATE TABLE "ErrorLog" (
  "ErrorLogID" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "ErrorTime" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "UserName" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "ErrorNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "ErrorSeverity" INTEGER,
  "ErrorState" INTEGER,
  "ErrorProcedure" TEXT,
  "ErrorLine" INTEGER,
  "ErrorMessage" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("ErrorLogID")
)
